title: Recommendation of International Covenants by Central Authority

content.scenario: The Central Authority identifies a need to adopt international best practices to protect consumer rights in e-commerce transactions. It decides to recommend the adoption of relevant international covenants to ensure effective enforcement of consumer rights.
content.outcome: The Central Authority recommends the adoption of international covenants and best international practices on consumer rights to the government, to ensure effective enforcement of consumer rights in e-commerce transactions.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Authority in recommending international covenants?
Can the Central Authority adopt international best practices on its own?
How does the Central Authority ensure effective enforcement of consumer rights?
